QUICK RULES

01 / MATCH

Match color or number. Number cards of the active system add mission progress.

02 / SUSPECT

Use Emergency Meeting to vote one player out. Ejected roles are revealed.

03 / WIN

Crew wins by finishing 3 missions or ejecting all traitors. Traitors win at 3 failures or parity.
